content.title: VOC Energy: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: HOUSTON (AP) — VOC Energy Trust (VOC) on Monday reported net income of $1.9 million in its third quarter. On a per-share basis, the Houston-based company said it had net income of 11 cents. The statutory trust with net profits interest in properties held by Vess Oil posted revenue of $2.2 million in the period.

content.title: VOC Energy: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: HOUSTON (AP) — VOC Energy Trust (VOC) on Tuesday reported earnings of $2.2 million in its second quarter. On a per-share basis, the Houston-based company said it had profit of 13 cents. The statutory trust with net profits interest in properties held by Vess Oil posted revenue of $2.5 million in the period.
